title: Stage 4 Output
description: Aggregated Quality Gate report + cover image selection, produced at end of Stage 4 for CP2.

layerReports.description: One report per Quality Gate layer (fact-check, seo-audit, anti-ai, legal, voice).

overallResult.description: PASS only if all 5 layers pass. FAIL if any layer has remaining critical issues.

coverImage.description: Selected cover image metadata. null until Gen picks at CP2.

altText.description: Alt text: primary keyword + descriptive, ≤125 chars.

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL (from Unsplash API response).

fixesApplied.description: Total number of auto-fixes applied across all layers.

remainingIssues.description: Count of unresolved issues by severity across all layers.
